name: fork-ui-followups
brief: Clear three fork-UI follow-ups from .sir/backlog.md:34-41. T1 fixes the Pod tab titles collapsing while the fork-error alert is shown: in the .chrome flex row the alert's flex basis is its whole one-line message, so it takes width from the Pod bar. T1 also bounds the alert's text to the 38px row and keeps the DOM hooks the driver reads, with a stylesheet-text regression test. T2 then amends the Playwright fork-UI driver in place. O11's control becomes position:relative;top:h, so the dismiss-button centring can be scored; tol and the ?? null lookups come under the null-initialised-reference rule; O14's wording and O16's control are fixed; meta's extra keys are folded into the report contract. T2 adds O17 (tab title widths) and O18 (alert inside the row), runs --slug fork-ui-followups, and records FINDINGS-FORK-UI-FOLLOWUPS.md. At Gate 3, backlog row :34 closes only if O11 passes.
